verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a `fireflies_create_soundbite` tool that creates a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript, so clipping a moment is supported. The only documented sharing capability shares whole meeting transcripts by email, and nothing shows the clip itself being shared. Missing for 10: evidence that a soundbite can be shared as a standalone moment, in-app UI docs for cutting highlights (beyond a one-line changelog entry for the MCP tool), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
